clauses.text: Deny new east-west communication from the payments namespace while preserving known service dependencies
Prevent privilege escalation by workloads in that namespace
Restrict the compromised workload's access to the Kubernetes API
clauses.note: Needs automountServiceAccountToken=false plus RBAC changes; RBAC is out of scope for an admission policy. Not generated.

clauses.text: Do not disrupt running workloads; roll out in stages and time-box any exception
clauses.note: Process constraint. Expressed as the rollout plan and exception TTLs, not as a policy.

restrict_api_access.note: Requires RBAC and ServiceAccount changes beyond admission control.

exceptions.reason: Nightly backup needs egress to the storage namespace until the backup target is moved behind the db profile.
